general.name: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
general.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.

general.name: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
general.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
general.description_zh: 一个用于多阶段安全审计的编程 agent 技能，可独立验证并生成机器可读的审计结果

general.name: stablyai/orca
general.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

general.name: DietrichGebert/ponytail
general.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
general.description_zh: 让你的 AI agent 像房间里最懒的资深开发者一样思考。最好的代码就是你从未写过的代码。

general.name: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
general.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.

general.name: ruvnet/ruflo
general.description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated

general.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
general.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

general.name: msitarzewski/agency-agents
general.description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.
general.description_zh: 触手可及的完整 AI 代理团队——从前端高手到 Reddit 社区忍者，从趣味注入者到现实检查员。每个 agent 都是兼具个性、流程与可靠成果的专业专家。
features: 精心打造的专业 AI agent 集合，每个 agent 拥有独特领域专长与个性
提供 macOS、Linux、Windows 原生桌面 app，一键安装 agent
支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI、OpenCode、Qwen、Osaurus 等工具
提供脚本化安装方式，可批量或按分类部署 agent
agent 具备实战验证的工作流、可交付成果与成功指标

general.name: headroomlabs-ai/headroom
general.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
general.description_zh: 在工具输出、日志、文件和 RAG 分块进入 LLM 前进行压缩。编程 agent 减少 20% token，JSON 减少 60-95% token，答案不变。提供库、代理和 MCP server。

general.name: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
general.description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
general.description_zh: 开源插件仓库，主要面向知识工作者在 Claude Cowork 中使用
features: 针对销售、法务、财务等岗位提供 11 个开源专业 plugin
每个 plugin 集成对应职能的 skills、connectors、slash commands 和 sub-agents
支持 Slack、Notion、Jira、Snowflake 等数百种企业工具 connector
可按公司工具、术语、流程自定义，使 Claude 适配团队
兼容 Claude Cowork 与 Claude Code 双平台运行

general.name: wshobson/agents
general.description: Multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Google Antigravity, and Pi

general.name: shiyu-coder/Kronos
general.description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
general.description_zh: Kronos：金融市场语言的基础模型
features: 面向金融 K 线数据预训练的首个开源 decoder-only 基础模型
通过专用 tokenizer 将 OHLCV 数据量化为分层离散 token
基于全球 45+ 交易所数据预训练的自回归 Transformer 模型
提供微调脚本，可适配自定义量化任务
支持 Hugging Face 模型加载与在线 Demo 体验

general.name: vllm-project/vllm
general.description: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs
